examples.dm: At that time, the Venerable Subhūti was also present and seated within that very assembly.
examples.gm: Also at that time, the Venerable Subhūti had assembled in that very retinue and was sitting there.
examples.sa: तेन खलु पुनः समयेनायुष्मान् सुभुतिस्तस्यामेव पर्षदि संनिपतितोऽभूत्संनिषण्णः।

examples.dm: Furthermore, Subhūti, any place where even a four-line stanza from this Dharma discourse is recited or taught becomes a shrine for the world including gods, humans, and asuras. It goes without saying that anyone who takes up, writes down, holds, preserves, reads, masters, and properly attends to this Dharma discourse will be endowed with supreme wonder.
examples.gm: Moreover, Subhūti, if the place where even a four-line verse from this discourse on the Dharma is recited or taught becomes a stūpa for the world with its gods, humans, and asuras, what need to speak of whoever takes up this discourse on the Dharma, writes it, holds it, keeps it, reads it, masters it, and attends to it properly becoming endowed with the greatest wonder?
examples.sa: अपि तु खलु पुनः सुभुते यस्मिन् पृथिवीप्रदेशे इतो धर्मपर्यायादन्तशश्चतुष्पादिकामपि गाथामुद्गृह्य भाष्येत वा संप्रकाश्येत वा, स पृथिवीप्रदेशश्चैत्यभूतो भवेत् सदेवमानुषासुरस्य लोकस्य, कः पुनर्वादो ये इमं धर्मपर्यायं सकलसमाप्तं धारयिष्यन्ति वाचयिष्यन्ति पर्यवाप्स्यन्ति, परेभ्यश्च विस्तरेण संप्रकाशयिष्यन्ति। परमेण ते सुभूते आश्चर्येण समन्वागता भविष्यन्ति।

examples.dm: "Blessed One, it is wonderful how the Tathāgata, the Arhat, the perfectly complete Buddha, has so greatly benefited the bodhisattva mahāsattvas with the supreme benefits, and how the Tathāgata has so greatly entrusted the bodhisattva mahāsattvas with the supreme entrustments. Blessed One, it is wonderful! Sugata, it is wonderful!"
examples.gm: Blessed One, the supreme benefit with which the Tathāgata, the Arhat, the Perfectly Awakened Buddha has benefited the bodhisattva great beings, and the supreme entrustment with which the Tathāgata has entrusted the bodhisattva great beings—it is wonderful, O Blessed One! It is wonderful, O Sugata!
examples.sa: आश्चर्यं भगवन्,परमाश्चर्यं सुगत,यावदेव तथागतेनार्हता सम्यक्संबुद्धेन बोधिसत्त्वा महासत्त्वा अनुपरिगृहीताः परमेणानुग्रहेण। आश्चर्यं भगवन् यावदेव तथागतेनार्हता सम्यक्संबुद्धेन बोधिसत्त्वा महासत्त्वाः परीन्दिताः परमया परीन्दनया।

examples.dm: Do you think that there is any dharma that the Tathāgata obtained from the Tathāgata, Arhat, Perfectly Complete Buddha Dīpaṃkara?"
examples.gm: Do you think there is any Dharma that the Tathāgata received from the Tathāgata, the Arhat, the perfectly and fully awakened Buddha Dīpaṃkara?
examples.sa: अस्ति स कश्चिद्धर्मो यस्तथागतेन दीपंकरस्य तथागतस्यार्हत-सम्यक्संबुद्धस्यान्तिकादुद्गृहीतः?

examples.dm: Subhūti, the mass of merit of a bodhisattva who practices generosity without abiding is not easy to measure, Subhūti.
examples.gm: Subhūti, it is because the heap of merit of a bodhisattva who gives gifts without abiding is not easy to measure, Subhūti.
examples.sa: तत्कस्य हेतोः ? यः सुभूते बोधिसत्त्वोऽप्रतिष्ठितो दानं ददाति, तस्य सुभूते पुण्यस्कन्धस्य न सुकरं प्रमाणामुद्ग्रहीतुम्।

examples.dm: Subhūti, all those sentient beings will generate and gather an immeasurable mass of merit.
examples.gm: Subhūti, all those sentient beings will produce and completely gather an immeasurable aggregate of merit.
examples.sa: सर्वे ते सुभूते अप्रमेयमसंख्येयं पुण्यस्कन्धं प्रसविष्यन्ति प्रतिग्रहीष्यन्ति।

examples.dm: If some son or daughter of noble family were to fill this trichiliocosm world system with the seven kinds of precious substances and give them as a gift, would that son or daughter of noble family generate much merit on that basis?
examples.gm: If some son of noble family or daughter of noble family were to fill this three-thousandfold great thousandfold world system with the seven precious substances and give it as a gift, do you think that son of noble family or daughter of noble family would generate a great mass of merit from that basis?
examples.sa: यः कश्चित्कुलपुत्रो वा कुलदुहिता वा इमं त्रिसाहस्रमहासाहस्रं लोकधातुं सप्तरत्नपरिपूर्णं कृत्वा तथागतेभ्योऽर्हद्भयः सम्यक्संबुद्धेभ्यो दानं दद्यात्, अपि नु स कुलपुत्रो वा कुलदुहिता वा ततोनिदानं बहु पुण्यस्कन्धं प्रसुनुयात्।

examples.gm: If some son of noble family or daughter of noble family were to fill this three-thousandfold great thousandfold world system with the seven precious substances and give it as a gift, do you think that son of noble family or daughter of noble family would generate a great mass of merit from that basis?
examples.sa: यः कश्चित्कुलपुत्रो वा कुलदुहिता वा इमं त्रिसाहस्रमहासाहस्रं लोकधातुं सप्तरत्नपरिपूर्णं कृत्वा तथागतेभ्योऽर्हद्भयः सम्यक्संबुद्धेभ्यो दानं दद्यात्, अपि नु स कुलपुत्रो वा कुलदुहिता वा ततोनिदानं बहु पुण्यस्कन्धं प्रसुनुयात्।

examples.dm: The Blessed One said: Subhūti, if a son or daughter of noble family were to fill this trichiliocosm of great thousand-fold world systems with the seven types of precious substances and give them as a gift, and if another were to take up from this discourse on Dharma even just a four-line verse and explain it to others and correctly demonstrate it, they would generate a mass of merit from that basis that is far greater, incalculable, and immeasurable.
examples.gm: The Blessed One spoke: Subhūti, compared to some son of noble family or daughter of noble family filling this three-thousandfold great thousandfold world system with the seven precious substances and giving it as a gift, whoever takes up even just a four-line verse from this discourse on dharma, teaches it to others, and perfectly explains it will generate a much greater mass of merit from that basis, countless and immeasurable.
examples.sa: भगवानाह-यश्च खलु पुनः सुभूते कुलपुत्रो वा कुलदुहिता व इमं त्रिसाहस्रमहासाहस्रं लोकधातुं सप्तरत्नपरिपूर्णं कृत्वा तथागतेभ्योऽर्हद्भ्यः सम्यक्संबुद्धेभ्यो दानं दद्यात्, यश्च इतो धर्मपर्यायादन्तशश्चतुष्पादिकामपि गाथामुद्गृह्य परेभ्यो विस्तरेण देशयेत् संप्रकाशयेत्, अयमेव ततोनिदानं बहुतरं पुण्यस्कन्धं प्रसुनुयादप्रमेयसंख्येयम्।

examples.dm: If a man or a woman were to fill as many world systems as there are grains of sand in those Ganges Rivers with the seven types of precious jewels,
examples.gm: If some man or woman were to completely fill as many world systems as there are grains of sand in those Gaṅgā rivers with the seven precious substances,
examples.sa: यावत्यस्तासु गङ्गानदीषु वालुका भवेयुस्तावतो लोकधातून् कश्चिदेव स्त्री वा पुरुषो वा सप्तरत्नपरिपुर्णं कृत्वा

examples.dm: Do you think that there is any phenomenon whatsoever by which the Tathāgata has fully awakened to unsurpassed, perfect, and complete enlightenment?
examples.gm: Do you think there is any dharma whatsoever to which the Tathāgata has manifestly and completely awakened as unsurpassed, perfectly complete awakening?
examples.sa: अस्ति स कश्चिद्धर्मो यस्तथागतेनानुत्तरा सम्यक्संबोधिरित्यभिसंबुद्धः,

examples.dm: Furthermore, Subhūti, there is neither truth nor falsehood in the phenomena that the Tathāgata has perfectly awakened to or taught.
examples.gm: Moreover, Subhūti, in whatever phenomena the Tathāgata has fully awakened to or taught, there is neither truth nor falsehood.
examples.sa: अपि तु खलु पुनः सुभूते यस्तथागतेन धर्मोऽभिसंबुद्धो देशितो निध्यातः, न तत्र सत्यं न मृषा।

examples.dm: Do you think that there is any phenomenon whatsoever that the Tathāgata has fully realized as unsurpassed, perfectly complete enlightenment from the Tathāgata Dīpaṃkara?
examples.gm: Do you think there is any dharma whatsoever by which the Tathāgata fully awakened to unsurpassable, perfectly complete awakening from the Tathāgata Dīpaṃkara?
examples.sa: अस्ति स कश्चिद्धर्मो यस्तथागतेन दीपंकरस्य तथागतस्यान्तिकादनुत्तरां सम्यक्संबोधिमभिसंबुद्धः ?

examples.dm: Blessed One, how should one who has correctly entered the bodhisattva vehicle abide?
examples.gm: O Blessed One, how should one who has correctly entered the bodhisattva vehicle abide?
examples.sa: तत्कथं भगवन् बोधिसत्त्वयानसंप्रस्थितेन कुलपुत्रेण वा कुलदुहित्रा वा स्थातव्यं

examples.dm: The Blessed One said, "Subhūti, in this regard, one who has correctly entered the path of the bodhisattva should know, see, and resolve to understand all phenomena in this way:
examples.gm: The Blessed One said: Subhūti, thus should those who have truly entered the bodhisattva vehicle know, see, and be resolved upon all dharmas,
examples.sa: भगवानाह-एवं हि सुभूते बोधिसत्त्वयानसंप्रस्थितेन सर्वधर्मा ज्ञातव्या द्रष्टव्या अधिमोक्तव्याः।

examples.dm: Blessed One, how should those who have correctly entered the bodhisattva vehicle abide?
examples.gm: Blessed One, how should those who have correctly entered the bodhisattva vehicle dwell?
examples.sa: कथं भगवन् बोधिसत्त्वयानसंप्रस्थितेन स्थातव्यम्,

examples.dm: Blessed One, in the final five-hundred-year period of the future, when the holy Dharma is about to completely perish, will there be any sentient beings who will arise to form a correct perception of such explanations of the words of a sutra as this?
examples.gm: Blessed One, will there appear any sentient beings in the future time, in the last five hundred years, when the true Dharma is being destroyed, who will produce a true perception regarding the spoken words of a sūtra such as this?
examples.sa: अस्ति भगवन्। केचित्सत्त्वा भविष्यन्त्यनागतेऽध्वनि पश्चिमे काले पश्चिमे समये पश्चिमायां पञ्चशत्यां सद्धर्मविप्रलोपकाले वर्तमाने, ये इमेष्वेवंरूपेषु सूत्रान्तपदेषु भाष्यमाणेषु भूतसंज्ञामुत्पादयिष्यन्ति।

examples.dm: Subhūti, those who will attain even a single moment of faith of mind regarding such explanations of the sūtra as this, the Tathāgata knows them.
examples.gm: Subhūti, the Tathāgata knows those who will obtain even a single thought of faith regarding the teaching of a sūtra such as this.
examples.sa: ये इमेष्वेवंरूपेषु सूत्रान्तपदेषु भाष्यमाणेषु एकचित्तप्रसादमपि प्रतिलप्स्यन्ते। ज्ञातास्ते सुभूते तथागतेन बुद्धज्ञानेन,

examples.dm: Those sentient beings who, when this sūtra is being explained, are not terrified, not frightened, and do not become alarmed, will be endowed with supreme wonder.
examples.gm: Those sentient beings who are not terrified, not frightened, and do not become completely terrified when this sūtra is being taught will be endowed with supreme wonder.
examples.sa: परमाश्चर्यसमन्वागतास्ते सत्त्वा भविष्यन्ति, ये इह सुभूते सूत्रे भाष्यमाणे नोत्रसिष्यन्ति न संत्रसिष्यन्ति न संत्रासमापत्स्यन्ते।

examples.dm: Subhūti, those who have truly entered the bodhisattva vehicle should think in this way: "As many sentient beings as are included in the category of sentient beings—whether born from eggs, born from wombs, born from warmth and moisture, or born miraculously; whether having form or without form; whether having perception or without perception, or neither with perception nor without perception—all those sentient beings I shall lead to complete nirvāṇa in the realm of nirvāṇa that leaves no remainder of the aggregates."
examples.gm: Subhūti, here one who has correctly entered the bodhisattva vehicle should form this thought: 'As many beings as are subsumed in the collection of beings—whether born from eggs, born from wombs, born from heat and moisture, or miraculously born; whether having form or formless; whether having perception, having no perception, or neither having nor lacking perception; however many are conceptually designated as the realm of beings—all these I shall lead to complete nirvāṇa in the realm of nirvāṇa without remainder of aggregates.'
examples.sa: इह सुभूते बोधिसत्त्वयानसंप्रस्थितेनैव चित्तमुत्पादयितव्यम्-यावन्तः सुभूते सत्त्वाः सत्त्वधातौ सत्त्वसंग्रहेण संगृहीता अण्डजा वा जरायुजा वा संस्वेदजा वा औपपादुका वा रूपिणो वा अरूपिणो वा संज्ञिनो वा असंज्ञिनो वा नैवसंज्ञिनो नासंज्ञिनो वा, यावान् कश्चित्सत्त्वधातुः प्रज्ञप्यमानः प्रज्ञप्यते, ते च मया सर्वेऽनुपधिशेषे निर्वाणधातौ परिनिर्वापयितव्याः।

examples.gm: If some son of noble family or daughter of noble family were to fill this three-thousandfold great thousandfold world system with the seven precious substances and give it as a gift, do you think that son of noble family or daughter of noble family would generate a great mass of merit from that basis?

examples.gm: That son of noble family or daughter of noble family would generate a great mass of merit from that basis.

examples.dm: The Blessed One said, "Subhūti, if any bodhisattva were to say, 'I shall accomplish the adornment of the buddha-fields,' he would be speaking untruthfully."
examples.gm: The Blessed One said: Subhūti, if any bodhisattva were to say, 'I will accomplish the array of the fields,' they would be speaking falsely.
examples.sa: भगवानाह-यः कश्चित्सुभूते बोधिसत्त्व एवं वदेत्-अहं क्षेत्रव्यूहान् निष्पादयिष्यामीति, स वितथं वदेत्।

examples.dm: Furthermore, Subhūti, if a bodhisattva were to say, "I shall accomplish the arrays of buddhafields," that should also be spoken of in that same way.
examples.gm: Moreover, Subhūti, if any bodhisattva were to speak thus: 'I shall accomplish the arrays of the fields,' he too would be spoken of in the same way.
examples.sa: यः सुभूते बोधिसत्त्व एवं वदेत्- अहं क्षेत्रव्यूहान्निष्पादयिष्यामीति, स वितथं वदेत्।

examples.dm: Therefore, it is called "adornment of the buddha-fields."
examples.gm: therefore, they are called 'the array of the fields.'
examples.sa: तेनोच्यन्ते क्षेत्रव्यूहा इति।

examples.dm: Likewise, they should practice generosity without abiding in sound, smell, taste, tangible objects, or phenomena.
examples.gm: Likewise, without abiding in sounds, smells, tastes, tactile objects, or mental phenomena, they should give gifts.
examples.sa: न शब्दगन्धरसस्प्रष्टव्यधर्मेषु प्रतिष्ठितेन दानं दातव्यम्।

examples.gm: Moreover, Subhūti, if the place where even a four-line verse from this discourse on the Dharma is recited or taught becomes a stūpa for the world with its gods, humans, and asuras, what need to speak of whoever takes up this discourse on the Dharma, writes it, holds it, keeps it, reads it, masters it, and attends to it properly becoming endowed with the greatest wonder?

examples.dm: Subhūti, regarding the fact that I pleased those Buddhas, the Blessed Ones, and did not cause their hearts to be troubled, and regarding the fact that in the final period, in the last five hundred years, there will be those who take up, inquire into, uphold, recite, read, and fully comprehend this sūtra—Subhūti, compared to this mass of merit, that previous mass of merit does not approach even a hundredth part.
examples.gm: Subhūti, whatever pleasing and not disappointing of those buddhas, the Blessed Ones, I did, compared to whoever, when the last five hundred years of the latter time have come, takes up, writes, holds, keeps, reads, and completely comprehends this sūtra—Subhūti, the former heap of merit does not approach even a hundredth part of this heap of merit;
examples.sa: यच्च मया सुभूते ते बुद्धा भगवन्त आरागिताः, आराग्य न विरागिताः, यच्च पश्चिमे काले पश्चिमे समये पश्चिमायां पञ्चशत्यां सद्धर्मविप्रलोपकाले वर्तमाने इमानेवंरूपान् सूत्रान्तानुद्ग्रहीष्यन्ति धारयिष्यन्ति वाचयिष्यन्ति पर्यवाप्स्यन्ति, परेभ्यश्च विस्तरेण संप्रकाशयिष्यन्ति, अस्य खलु पुनः सुभूते पुण्यस्कन्धस्यान्तिकादसौ पौर्वकः पुण्यस्कन्धः शततमीमपि कलां नोपैति,

examples.dm: Furthermore, Subhūti, if a son or daughter of noble family were to fill as many world systems as there are grains of sand in the river Ganges with the seven types of precious jewels and give them as a gift, and if a bodhisattva were to gain patience in the realization that phenomena are without self and unborn, then that bodhisattva would generate a mass of merit far greater, immeasurable, and incalculable than that.
examples.gm: Moreover, Subhūti, if a son of good family or a daughter of good family were to fill as many world systems as there are grains of sand in the river Ganges with the seven precious things and give them as a gift, and if a Bodhisattva were to attain the patience that this Dharma-discourse is selfless and unproduced, he would produce from that basis a mass of merit vastly greater, incalculable and immeasurable.

examples.gm: Subhūti, if you think that those who have genuinely set out in the Bodhisattva vehicle have destroyed some phenomenon or designated it as annihilated, Subhūti, it should not be seen like that.
examples.sa: न खलु पुनस्ते सुभूते कश्चिदेवं वदेत्-बोधिसत्त्वयानसंप्रस्थितैः कस्यचिद्धर्मस्य विनाशः प्रज्ञप्तः उच्छेदो वेति। न खलु पुनस्ते सुभूते एवं द्रष्टव्यम्। तत्कस्य हेतोः ?

examples.bo: རབ་འབྱོར་འདི་ལ་བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའི་ཐེག་པ་ལ་ཡང་དག་པར་ཞུགས་པས། འདི་སྙམ་དུ་བདག་གིས་སེམས་ཅན་ཇི་ཙམ་སེམས་ཅན་དུ་བསྡུ་བས་བསྡུས་པ། སྒོ་ང་ལས་སྐྱེས་པའམ། མངལ་ལས་སྐྱེས་པའམ། དྲོད་གཤེར་ལས་སྐྱེས་པའམ། རྫུས་ཏེ་སྐྱེས་པའམ། གཟུགས་ཅན་ནམ། གཟུགས་ཅན་མ་ཡིན་པའམ། འདུ་ཤེས་ཅན་ནམ། འདུ་ཤེས་མེད་འདུ་ཤེས་མེད་མིན་ནམ། སེམས་ཅན་གྱི་ཁམས་ཇི་ཙམ་སེམས་ཅན་དུ་གདགས་པའི་བརྟགས་པ་དེ་དག་ཐམས་ཅད་ཕུང་པོ་ལྷག་མ་མེད་པའི་མྱ་ངན་ལས་འདས་པའི་དབྱིངས་སུ་ཡོངས་སུ་མྱ་ངན་ལས་འདའོ། །
examples.dm: Subhūti, those who have truly entered the bodhisattva vehicle should think in this way: "As many sentient beings as are included in the category of sentient beings—whether born from eggs, born from wombs, born from warmth and moisture, or born miraculously; whether having form or without form; whether having perception or without perception, or neither with perception nor without perception—all those sentient beings I shall lead to complete nirvāṇa in the realm of nirvāṇa that leaves no remainder of the aggregates."
examples.gm: Subhūti, here one who has correctly entered the bodhisattva vehicle should form this thought: 'As many beings as are subsumed in the collection of beings—whether born from eggs, born from wombs, born from heat and moisture, or miraculously born; whether having form or formless; whether having perception, having no perception, or neither having nor lacking perception; however many are conceptually designated as the realm of beings—all these I shall lead to complete nirvāṇa in the realm of nirvāṇa without remainder of aggregates.'
examples.sa: इह सुभूते बोधिसत्त्वयानसंप्रस्थितेनैव चित्तमुत्पादयितव्यम्-यावन्तः सुभूते सत्त्वाः सत्त्वधातौ सत्त्वसंग्रहेण संगृहीता अण्डजा वा जरायुजा वा संस्वेदजा वा औपपादुका वा रूपिणो वा अरूपिणो वा संज्ञिनो वा असंज्ञिनो वा नैवसंज्ञिनो नासंज्ञिनो वा, यावान् कश्चित्सत्त्वधातुः प्रज्ञप्यमानः प्रज्ञप्यते, ते च मया सर्वेऽनुपधिशेषे निर्वाणधातौ परिनिर्वापयितव्याः।

examples.dm: "Even though immeasurable sentient beings are thus led to complete nirvāṇa, one should generate the mind thinking that not even one sentient being has been led to complete nirvāṇa."
examples.gm: One should generate the mind thinking: 'Even though immeasurable beings have thus been led to complete nirvāṇa, no being whatsoever has been led to complete nirvāṇa.'
examples.sa: एवमपरिमाणानपि सत्त्वान् परिनिर्वाप्य न कश्चित्सत्त्वः परिनिर्वापितो भवति।

examples.dm: The Blessed One said, "Subhūti, is it easy to measure the extent of space in the south, the west, the north, the zenith, the nadir, the intermediate directions, and the ten directions?"
examples.gm: The Blessed One said: Subhūti, likewise, is it easy to measure the space in the south, west, north, the directions above and below, the intermediate directions, and the ten directions?

examples.dm: Subhūti, it is like this: for example, if a person were to have a body such as this, that is to say, if it were to become as large as Mount Sumeru, the king of mountains, Subhūti, what do you think? Would that body be large?
examples.gm: Subhūti, suppose, for example, a person were to have a body like this: that is, as large as Sumeru, the king of mountains. Subhūti, what do you think? Would you think that body is large?

examples.dm: Blessed One, ever since I attained the eye of wisdom, I have never before heard such a discourse on Dharma as this.
examples.gm: Bhagavān, since wisdom arose in me, I have never before heard this discourse on Dharma.
examples.sa: श्रेष्ठयानसंप्रस्थितानामर्थाय, यतो मे भगवन् ज्ञानमुत्पन्नम्। न मया भगवन् जात्वेवंरूपो धर्मपर्यायः श्रुतपूर्वः।

examples.dm: Subhūti, I recall that in a past age, when I was a sage called "Speaker of Patience" for five hundred lifetimes, even at that time I had no notion of a self.
examples.gm: Subhūti, I remember that in the past, for five hundred lifetimes, when I was the sage called Kṣāntivādin, even at that time the perception of a self did not arise in me.

examples.gm: Why is that? examples.dm: Furthermore, Subhūti, if a son or daughter of noble family were to fill as many world systems as there are grains of sand in the river Ganges with the seven types of precious jewels and give them as a gift, and if a bodhisattva were to gain patience in the realization that phenomena are without self and unborn, then that bodhisattva would generate a mass of merit far greater, immeasurable, and incalculable than that.
examples.gm: Moreover, Subhūti, if a son of good family or a daughter of good family were to fill as many world systems as there are grains of sand in the river Ganges with the seven precious things and give them as a gift, and if a Bodhisattva were to attain the patience that this Dharma-discourse is selfless and unproduced, he would produce from that basis a mass of merit vastly greater, incalculable and immeasurable.
